title.en: INSTITUT TEKNOLOGI BRUNEI ACT AMENDMENT ORDER 2017

text.en: This Order may be cited as the Institut Teknologi Brunei Act (Amendment) Order, 2017 and is deemed to have commenced on 1st March 2016.

heading.en: Substitution of long title of Chapter 214

text.en: The long title of the Institut Teknologi Brunei Act, in this Order referred to as the Act, is repealed and substituted with the following new long title "An Act to establish a university known as Universiti Teknologi Brunei and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto".
Section 1 of the Act is amended by deleting "Institut" and by substituting "Universiti" therefor.

Section 2 of the Act is amended -

(a) by deleting the definition of "Institute" and by substituting the following new definition immediately after the definition in the appropriate alphabetical order - " "Universiti" means the Universiti Teknologi Brunei established under

(b) in the definition of "Minister", by deleting the full stop and by substituting a semicolon therefor.

Section 3 of the Act is amended by repealing subsection (1) and by substituting the following new subsection therefor - "(1) There is hereby established a university, known by the name and style "Universiti Teknologi Brunei" and by which name and style constitutes a body corporate having perpetual succession.".
Section 9 of the Act is amended by deleting "Institut" from the second last line and by substituting "Universiti" therefor.
The Act is amended by deleting "Institute" wherever that word appears and by substituting "Universiti" therefor. Saving of contracts etc.

All contracts, agreements, conveyances, covenants, settlements, trusts, deeds, leases, licenses and other instruments or undertakings entered into by or made with or addressed to the Institut Teknologi Brunei or to which the Institut Teknologi Brunei is a party (whether alone or with any other person) and in force before or on the commencement date of this Order shall, as from that date, be binding and of full force and effect in every respect against or in favour of the Universiti Teknologi Brunei as fully and effectually as if, instead of the Institut TeknoIogi Brunei, the Universiti Teknologi Brunei had been a party thereto or bound thereby or entitled to the benefit thereof. Made this 28th. day of Rabiulakhir, 1438 Hijriah corresponding to the 26th. day of January, 2017 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM
